boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study settings in Lavery Library, from silent study to group-ready rooms and technology-equipped spaces.

cards.title: Settle into John S. D'Amico Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor
cards.notes: Choose this designated silent-study space when you need focused reading or writing; keep conversation and audio out of the room.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library identifies the John S. D'Amico Silent Study as a sanctuary for quiet, focused work; library maps place it on the third floor.
cards.access_notes: Fisher students, faculty, and staff may use library open spaces; select a space that respects its designated noise level.

cards.title: Use the 24/7 Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library north side, outside second-floor entrances
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use the available computers in this north-side hallway, which has varied seating for Fisher student work.
cards.short_summary: An after-hours hallway workspace with seating and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: The library's 24/7 Study Hall is outside the second-floor north-side entrances and includes varied seating and computers for Fisher student use.
cards.access_notes: The policy identifies this as a 24/7 Study Hall for Fisher student use; it may also be used for tabling or informational events.

cards.entity_name: Bob '74 and Terry Dumas Cardinals' Perch
cards.title: Gather at the Cardinals' Perch
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library
cards.notes: Use the Cardinals' Perch for a collaborative session, and shift to another library space if your work needs a quieter setting.
cards.short_summary: A named collaborative seating area in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library lists the Bob '74 and Terry Dumas Cardinals' Perch among its flexible learning and lounging spaces.
cards.access_notes: Library open spaces are available to the Fisher community, with priority given to Fisher students and respect for designated noise levels.

cards.title: Work from the Ullrich Atrium
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library
cards.notes: Use the atrium's social stairs and shared seating for a brief reading block or a conversation that belongs in a collaborative area.
cards.short_summary: A named atrium with social stairs and flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library identifies the Christopher '72 and Betsy Ullrich Atrium and its social stairs as part of its flexible learning and lounging spaces.
cards.access_notes: Library open spaces serve the Fisher community; choose a space and noise level appropriate to the work you are doing.

cards.title: Open a second-floor study room
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a room sized for your group and technology needs; take headphones for audio and remove belongings when leaving for an extended time.
cards.short_summary: First-come, first-served rooms near library services.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library's second-floor map lists study rooms, while its room-use policy says study rooms are first-come, first-served and vary in technology and size.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are first-come, first-served; large rooms are for two or more people, though an individual may use an unoccupied room until asked to relocate.

cards.entity_name: Lavery Library Third-Floor Group and Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Pick a third-floor group or individual room
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor
cards.notes: Match the room to solo focus or group work, use headphones for audio, and be prepared to relocate if staff need the space for testing.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor rooms designated for individual and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The third-floor Lavery Library map lists both group and individual study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are first-come, first-served, and library staff may ask users to relocate for technology, noise, time, or testing needs.

cards.title: Use Writing and Tutoring Room 302
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor
cards.notes: Check whether tutoring is underway before settling in; when the room is open, keep it quiet and use headphones for any audio.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor room that is available outside tutoring use.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library's room-use policy identifies Writing and Tutoring Room 302, gives priority to tutoring, and says it is otherwise available for students.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring has priority. Unless in use for tutoring, the room is available to students; maintain a quiet atmosphere and use headphones for audio.

cards.title: Use Writing and Tutoring Room 303
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use this room for quiet work when it is not serving tutoring; keep headphones handy and move if staff need it for tutoring.
cards.short_summary: A second designated writing-and-tutoring room for quiet work.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library's room-use policy identifies Writing and Tutoring Room 303, gives priority to tutoring, and says it is otherwise available for students.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring has priority. Unless in use for tutoring, the room is available to students; maintain a quiet atmosphere and use headphones for audio.

cards.title: Plan a session in the Pritchard Family Seminar Room
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor, L-306
cards.notes: Use this 14-seat classroom only when it is not in use by a library building partner; confirm availability before bringing a group.
cards.short_summary: A named third-floor seminar room with 14 seats.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library maps list the Pritchard Family Seminar Room as L-306; the room-use policy lists L-306 as a 14-seat classroom.
cards.access_notes: Group spaces may be reserved only for building-partner events; when not in use by those partners, they are open and available for students.

cards.entity_name: Steven W. '84 and Susan M. Barnstead Classroom
cards.title: Spread out in the Barnstead Classroom
cards.subtitle: Lavery Library, third floor, L-319
cards.notes: For a group work block, check whether this 24-seat classroom is already being used by a building partner before settling in.
cards.evidence_claim: Lavery Library maps list the Steven W. '84 and Susan M. Barnstead Classroom as L-319; the room-use policy lists L-319 as a 24-seat classroom.
cards.access_notes: Group spaces may be reserved only for building-partner events; when not in use by those partners, they are open and available for students.
